# Post-install event data

> Pass post-install event data from your app to Unity Ads through an MMP to optimize user acquisition campaigns based on real user engagement, such as sessions, purchases, ad revenue, and level completions.

Unity Ads User Acquisition campaigns that are optimized for acquiring particular kinds of users, such as [Retention](/grow/acquire/campaigns/retention/retention-campaigns.md), [Return on Ad Spend](/grow/acquire/campaigns/roas/return-on-ad-spend-campaigns.md) (ROAS), and [Event](/grow/acquire/campaigns/event/event-campaigns.md) campaigns, require information about how users engage with your app after installing it. Impression-Level User Revenue API for MMPs
This API uses a publisher-subscriber architecture.
The MAX SDK broadcasts MAX ad revenue events and MMPs subscribe to the
max_revenue_events
topic.
AppLovin recommends that you subscribe to that topic immediately after your app launches.
This way, you will not miss events.

User-Level Ad Revenue API
Use this API to retrieve user-level revenue data.
You can retrieve this data aggregated for a particular user or with one row per impression.
User-level revenue data is available eight hours after UTC day end.
For example, data for UTC 2019‒01‒01 is available on UTC 2019‒01‒02 after 08:00.
You can share user-level and impression-level ad revenue data with your mobile measurement partner of choice, such as
Adjust, AppsFlyer, GameAnalytics or Singular, for all supported networks
.
You can also access impression-level user revenue data on the client side.
You can read more about this in SDK integration guides >
